reviews.author: Justin Brammer
reviews.text: Been taking my car here for over a year and they have always been able to fit me in last minute. My alternator went out in Charlotte and I called Heltons and he coordinated a tow truck to come get my car and I. They fixed it the same day for a very reasonable price. Heltons has always gone above and beyond for me and I will continue to use them every time.

reviews.author: Veronica Mowery
reviews.text: Excellent place! Honest, reliable and no run around. Fast service, knowledgeable and great atmosphere. Just the best, would recommend to everyone!

reviews.author: donald petty
reviews.text: Howard and his crew appear to be some nice fellas's. This is my first time meeting them I'm waiting to get my Son's car completely fixed I will leave more of a review once all the repair work is done! Don Petty Gastonia
